branch_scope: Final JZ is checked via ZF=1/0, but its displacement is zero, so taken and fall-through both target code_end; this fixture does not test distinct branch routing.
cache_and_mapping_policy: No translation-cache lookup or cache entry. One MAP_JIT PublishedCode mapping at a time; publication is separate from repeated execution; each budget mapping is dropped before publishing the other.

calibration.wall_bound_derivation: Measured-side ceiling is 3s; the 16,777,216-call and cooperative 180s post-preflight calibration limits remain active. One observed condition (budget4, equal state) measured 181,908,558ns native at 4,194,304 completed calls and 1,000,016,691ns interpreter at 3,582,464 completed calls before the prior 1s ceiling. Linear projection to 8,388,608 calls is 363,817,116ns native and about 2,341,614,044ns interpreter; both exceed the 200ms floor and fit the 3s ceiling. This is a single-condition feasibility estimate, not a claim about other cases or budgets. The 180s limit is checked at 256-call chunk boundaries and after teardown.

compile_timer_boundary: compile_block_with_register_homes: block build/decode, lowering, allocation, ARM64 emission, finalization, and destruction of each unpublished CompiledBlock within the timed compile batch; excludes allocator-summary reconstruction, publication, execution, input reset and validation
execution_timer_boundary: Repeated PublishedCode::execute_block calls over the same retained artifact; state vectors are initialized before timing, and full-state/exit validation is outside timing. Interpreter uses the same initial state and code fetch adapter.
exit_normalization: Preserve raw tags. Normalize only BlockComplete versus InstructionBudgetExhausted when complete LongModeState matches, both retire exactly 6, both have zero remaining budget, and RIP equals code_end.
publication_timer_boundary: PublishedCode::publish_block and PublishedCode drop are timed and reported separately. The mapping remains live for warmup/timing; drop occurs after execution timing and before the other budget is published. These durations are never added to compile or execution samples.
sample_floor_policy: Retain every raw sample. A compile or execution side below 200ms sets sample_floor_passed=false and classifies the full process as diagnostic-only; no samples are trimmed and no comparison result should be scored.
scope: One frozen six-instruction register-only multi-helper block; budget4 baseline versus budget0 spill-only diagnostic. This does not choose an allocator globally.

variants.publication_lifetime: one preflight publication; dropped before next budget
